asset.name: MasterDetailWorkspace
asset.description: The list-and-detail workflow with route synchronization, preserved selection and scroll, independent loading boundaries per side, and drill-in navigation on compact viewports.

requires.reason: Adjacency, drill-in, and transition continuity are the shared layout.
Every generic state is delegated to the shared boundary rather than reimplemented per workflow.

signatureMoment.description: Returning from a detail view restores the list exactly as it was, including scroll position and selection, so a long triage pass is never interrupted by navigation.
